name: SpinLock
reason: spinLockCtor adds and resets per-task finalizer counters that new(0) does not construct, although the proposition states the unlocked owned value for every construction.

name: PaddedSpinLock
reason: paddedSpinLockCtor preinitializes owned and synthetic finalizer counters and replaces the source atomic store with a plain record update, although the proposition states the resulting owned value universally.

name: Base.assert_havelock
reason: spinAssertHavelock uses a supplied arbitrary result instead of calling Base.concurrency_violation and calls the plain-field Locks.spinIslocked model, so the proposition permits normal return when an unlocked lock is given an ok violation result.

name: lock
reason: spinLockLoop consumes caller-supplied successive lock states through the incomplete Locks.spinTrylock model, while its proposition covers only immediate acquisition and says nothing about any failed iteration, suspend, safepoint, or retry.

name: trylock
reason: spinTrylock rereads the same immutable owned value for the atomic swap, making the contended-swap failure branch unreachable, and its proposition only equates this model with the same reduced Locks.spinTrylock model.

name: unlock
reason: SpinUnlockProp specializes the CPU wake operation to identity and equates plain load and record updates with a model that also omits the release atomic swap and wake effect.

name: islocked
reason: spinIslocked calls the supplied monotonic load on owned before the nonzero comparison, and the universal proposition states exactly that Boolean result.
